name: Daily Renewal Scan
description: Daily. Reads active policies, finds those expiring in about 30 days, and raises ONE digest task listing them. A digest rather than a renewal quote per policy because a flow cannot loop — it reads many records but writes to one place. This flow is on a SCHEDULE, so unlike the two record-triggered flows it genuinely runs.

data.name: Find policies expiring in about 30 days

payload.code: (function(){var rows=(list&&list.results)||list||[];var from=Number(windowFrom)||29;var to=Number(windowTo)||31;var out=[],now=Date.now();for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){var d=rows[i].data||{};if(String(d.status||'')!=='Active')continue;if(!d.expiration_date)continue;var exp=Date.parse(d.expiration_date);if(isNaN(exp))continue;var days=Math.floor((exp-now)/86400000);if(days>=from&&days<=to){out.push('- '+(d.policy_reference||rows[i].id)+' — '+(d.insured_name||'unnamed')+' — '+(d.project_name||'no project')+' — expires '+d.expiration_date+' ('+days+' days) — premium '+(d.premium||0));}}return{count:out.length,body:out.join('\n')||'None.'};})();
